app.name: Muse Video Bridge
error.frame_too_large: A video frame exceeds the device size limit
error.unsupported_filesystem: Select a mounted FAT32 SD card.
error.unsupported_tool: The installed FFmpeg version lacks a required feature.
error.unsafe_path: The destination contains an unsafe or unrecognized file. Existing data was retained.
error.conversion_failed: Video conversion failed. Incomplete output was retained.
error.invalid_container: The prepared video is invalid or damaged.
error.unsupported_input: Select a supported local MP4 video.
error.stale_session: The device restarted. Reconnect to continue.
error.unsupported_firmware: The connected firmware does not support this protocol.
error.digest_mismatch: File verification failed. Existing data was retained.
error.card_full: The selected destination has insufficient free space.
error.file_too_large: The output exceeds the device file-size limit.
error.connection_failed: Could not open the selected connection. Check access permissions.
error.unsupported_jpeg: A frame uses an unsupported JPEG encoding.
error.timeout: The device did not reply after retries. Reconnect and resend the same prepared video to resume its verified checkpoint.
error.unsupported_platform: This operation is available for Windows and Linux targets.
error.offset_mismatch: The device rejected an upload chunk.
error.simulation_failed: The local test simulator could not start.
error.generic: Operation failed. See the technical details.
error.invalid_frame: The device sent an invalid protocol message.
empty.title: Bring your video to the small screen
empty.body: Select an MP4, prepare it for the display, and copy it to a FAT32 SD card.
preview.stale: Last known frame · connection is stale
preview.mismatch: Select and convert the matching video to follow the device.
preview.notCapture: Reconstructed preview, not a physical screen capture.
preview.canvas: Video positioned on a 320 by 240 display
video.quality: JPEG qscale · lower is higher quality
storage.complete: Video written and verified. Eject the card safely, then insert it into the ESP32.
storage.fat32: A mounted FAT32 card is required. The application never formats the card.
storage.usb_hint: Keep the microSD card in the device. Progress counts bytes acknowledged by the device.
device.simulator: Host test simulator · physical hardware unverified
live.title: Position and size
job.cancelled: Cancelled. Incomplete files were retained. Retry in a new job.
error.busy: Wait for the current operation or cancel it.
error.preview_mismatch: The device is playing a different prepared video.
error.no_video: The device has no valid video.
app.desktop_required: Launch the desktop application to access files and devices.
preview.unavailable: Preview unavailable. Try selecting or converting the video again.
queue.title: Video queue
queue.empty: No videos in the device queue. Add videos, prepare them, then send the selected videos over USB or write them to a mounted FAT32 SD card.
queue.limit: Up to 12 videos. Queue order and playback mode are saved on the SD card. Removing an entry keeps its video file.
error.queue_conflict: The device queue changed. Review its refreshed order and try again.
error.queue_full: The queue is full. Remove an entry before adding another video.
queue.write_many: Write selected videos to SD card
queue.legacy_limit: Up to 12 videos. This firmware resets the queue on restart; update the firmware to save queues on SD.
storage.slow_usb: Compatibility USB speed: this firmware uses 115200 baud. Install the updated fast-USB firmware to use 921600 baud. For large queues, writing directly to a mounted SD card is faster.
job.retrying_upload: Recovering USB transfer from the verified checkpoint
error.queue_save_failed: The SD queue could not be saved. Check free space and card health. Existing videos are retained.
error.sd_write_failed: The SD card could not write the video. Check the card and retry; completed videos are retained.
error.sd_flush_failed: The SD card could not finish saving data. Check free space and card health, then retry the transfer.
error.sd_checkpoint_failed: The SD card could not save the recovery checkpoint. Check free space and card health.
error.insufficient_space: The SD card does not have enough free space for this video and its recovery data.
error.sd_unavailable: The SD card is unavailable. Keep a FAT32 card installed in the CYD and reconnect.
error.sd_open_failed: The device could not open the video on SD. Check that the card is installed and readable.
error.sd_read_failed: The SD card could not read the video. Check the card and retry.
error.io_error: The USB or file operation failed. Check the connection and read the details below.
